description: VUnit verification components for VHDL testbenches: Ethernet (GMII, MII, RGMII, RMII, XGMII, AXI-Stream), QSPI NOR flash, and property-based testing with Hypothesis inside a simulation.
rules: Add the packages in run.py with vu.add_vhdl_builtins(), vu.add_verification_components(), vu.add_package("vunit-python-bridge", allow_setup=True) and vu.add_package("awesome-vunit-vcs").
A testbench needs one context clause: library awesome_vunit_vcs; context awesome_vunit_vcs.ethernet_context; (or flash_context, or property_context).
Create components with new_<component> and pass the handle as the entity's only generic; protocol checks come from a separate <interface>_protocol_checker handle given to the monitor.
Testbenches are VHDL and decide when things happen; Python modules build frames, packets, sequences and Hypothesis strategies.
Pass arguments to your Python functions from VHDL with typed kwarg(), kwarg_text() and kwarg_time(), never as Python source strings.
Call wait_until_idle(net, as_sync(handle)) before checking results, and reset(net, handle) between independent test parts.
Expected errors are counted with VUnit's disable_stop and get_log_count on the logger of the component that reports them.
